model: TN Series BACnet temperature sensor (BACnet MS/TP)
applies_to: Greystone TN series BACnet MS/TP temperature sensors in all mounting styles (all-purpose probe, duct, flexible averaging, room, outside, strap-on and others).
summary: The TN series are single-point temperature sensors with native BACnet MS/TP. They expose just three objects: the temperature, a calibration offset and a °C/°F units switch. The same object list is used across the TN mounting styles.
notes: Points from the TNAP installation guide; its PICS is written for the TN model family as a whole.
Changing BV 1 units resets the AV 1 offset to 0.
Baud rate (9600-115200) is auto-detected; the MAC address is set on the device.

source.title: BACnet All Purpose Temperature Sensor TNAP Series - Installation Instructions

integration.summary: Set the MAC on the device and let it auto-baud, then read AI 1. Pick °C or °F with BV 1 before setting any offset.
setup: Device instance defaults to 381000 + MAC (381001 at MAC 1); it stops following the MAC once written over BACnet.
Object name defaults to TN-<MAC>, e.g. TN-001.
gotchas: Writing BV 1 resets the temperature offset (AV 1) to 0.
